starters-new.definition: Not old; made or bought recently.
starters-new.hint: A new toy still has its tag.
starters-new.fact: Baby animals are new to the world.

starters-nice.hint: Say 'Have a nice day!' to be friendly.
starters-nice.fact: Nice people smile and help others.

starters-night.definition: The dark time when you sleep.
starters-night.hint: The moon and stars come out at night.

starters-no.definition: A word that means not yes.
starters-no.definitionVi: Không — phủ nhận, không đồng ý.
starters-no.hint: Shake your head when you say no.
starters-no.fact: Saying no can keep you safe.

starters-nose.definition: The part of your face you smell with.
starters-nose.hint: It is between your two eyes.
starters-nose.fact: Your nose can smell thousands of scents.

starters-not.definition: Shows something is untrue or wrong.
starters-not.hint: I am not sad means you feel fine.
starters-not.fact: Not is a small word with big meaning.

starters-now.hint: Do it now means do not wait.
starters-now.fact: Clocks help us know what time it is now.

starters-number.definition: A sign like 1, 2, or 3 for counting.
starters-number.fact: Zero is a number that means none.

starters-ok.fact: OK is understood in many countries.

starters-old.fact: Old trees can be hundreds of years old.

starters-onion.definition: A round vegetable that makes you cry.
starters-onion.definitionVi: Củ hành — ăn trong món ăn.
starters-onion.hint: It has layers like a ball.

starters-open.definition: Not closed; allowing people to enter.
starters-open.hint: The shop is open when you can go in.
starters-open.fact: Open doors let fresh air come in.

starters-orange.definition: A colour between red and yellow.
starters-orange.hint: Carrots and pumpkins can be orange.
starters-orange.fact: Orange is named after the fruit.

starters-page.definition: One side of paper in a book.
starters-page.hint: Turn the page to keep reading.

starters-paint.fact: Red and blue paint make purple.

starters-painting.hint: You might hang one on the wall.
starters-painting.fact: Some famous paintings are very old.

starters-paper.definition: Thin sheets you write or draw on.

starters-park.definition: A green outdoor place to play.
starters-park.definitionVi: Công viên — nơi chơi ngoài trời.
starters-park.hint: Swings and slides are in a park.
starters-park.fact: Parks have trees, grass, and benches.

starters-part.definitionVi: Một phần của cái gì đó.
starters-part.hint: Your hand is part of your body.
starters-part.fact: A puzzle has many parts that fit together.

starters-pea.fact: Peas are good for your body.

starters-pear.definition: A sweet fruit that is narrow at the top.
starters-pear.hint: It is softer than an apple.
starters-pear.fact: Pears can be green or yellow.

starters-pen.definition: A tool that writes with ink.
starters-pen.hint: Blue or black ink comes from a pen.
starters-pen.fact: Ballpoint pens were invented long ago.

starters-pencil.definition: A writing tool with lead inside.
starters-pencil.definitionVi: Bút chì để viết và vẽ.
starters-pencil.fact: Pencil lead is made from graphite.

starters-person.definition: A human being — a man, woman, or child.
starters-person.definitionVi: Con người — ai cũng là một person.
starters-person.fact: There are billions of people on Earth.

starters-pet.definition: An animal you keep at home.
starters-pet.hint: Dogs and cats are common pets.
starters-pet.fact: Pets need food, water, and love.

starters-phone.definition: A device for talking to people far away.
starters-phone.definitionVi: Điện thoại để gọi và nhắn tin.
starters-phone.hint: You tap the screen to call Mum.

starters-photo.definition: A picture taken with a camera.
starters-photo.fact: The first photos were black and white.

starters-piano.definition: A large musical instrument with black and white keys.
starters-piano.definitionVi: Đàn piano — nhạc cụ có phím.
starters-piano.hint: You press keys to play tunes.
starters-piano.fact: A piano can play very loud or soft.

starters-pick-up.definition: to lift something from the ground.
starters-pick-up.hint: Pick up your toys from the floor.
starters-pick-up.fact: You pick up a pencil to write.

starters-picture.definition: A drawing or photo you can look at.
starters-picture.hint: Books for kids have lots of pictures.
starters-picture.fact: A picture can tell a story without words.

starters-pie.definition: Food baked in a round pastry crust.
starters-pie.definitionVi: Bánh pie — nhân bọc trong vỏ bánh.
starters-pie.hint: Apple pie is a famous dessert.
starters-pie.fact: Pies can be sweet or savoury.

starters-pineapple.definition: A big tropical fruit with spiky skin.
starters-pineapple.definitionVi: Quả dứa — to, vỏ gai, vị ngọt.
starters-pineapple.hint: It has a leafy top like a crown.

starters-pink.definition: A light colour like a flower.
starters-pink.hint: Some pigs and flamingos look pink.
starters-pink.fact: Pink is made by mixing red and white.

starters-pl.definition: A polite word when you ask for something.
starters-pl.definitionVi: Xin vui lòng — nói lịch sự khi nhờ.
starters-pl.hint: Say please when you want help.
starters-pl.fact: Please and thank you are magic words.

starters-plane.definitionVi: Máy bay — phương tiện bay trên trời.
starters-plane.hint: Planes take off from an airport.
starters-plane.fact: Big planes can carry hundreds of people.

starters-play.definition: to have fun with games or toys.
starters-play.fact: Playing helps you learn and make friends.

starters-playground.definition: An outdoor area with swings and slides.
starters-playground.definitionVi: Sân chơi ở trường hoặc công viên.
starters-playground.hint: You run and climb here at break time.
starters-playground.fact: Playgrounds are built for safe fun.

starters-point.definition: to show something with your finger.
starters-point.definitionVi: Chỉ tay vào cái gì đó.
starters-point.hint: Point at the picture on the board.
starters-point.fact: Pointing helps others see what you mean.

starters-polar-bear.definition: A big white bear that lives on ice.
starters-polar-bear.definitionVi: Gấu Bắc Cực — gấu trắng sống ở Bắc Cực.
starters-polar-bear.hint: It swims in icy cold water.
starters-polar-bear.fact: Polar bears have thick fur to stay warm.

starters-poster.definition: A big picture put up on a wall.
starters-poster.fact: Posters can teach or decorate a room.

starters-potato.definition: A brown vegetable that grows underground.
starters-potato.hint: Chips and fries are made from potatoes.
starters-potato.fact: Potatoes can be baked, boiled, or mashed.

starters-pron-here.definition: In this place, where you are now.
starters-pron-here.hint: Come here means come to this spot.
starters-pron-here.fact: Here and there are place words.

starters-pron-hit.definitionVi: Đánh trúng, va vào cái gì.
starters-pron-hit.hint: Hit the ball with a bat.
starters-pron-hit.fact: In tennis you hit the ball over the net.

starters-purple.definition: A colour made from red and blue.
starters-purple.hint: Grapes and some flowers are purple.
starters-purple.fact: Purple was once a royal colour.

starters-put.definitionVi: Đặt, để cái gì ở đâu.
starters-put.hint: Put your bag on the chair.
starters-put.fact: Put your books away after class.

starters-question.definition: Words you ask when you want an answer.
starters-question.definitionVi: Câu hỏi khi muốn biết đáp án.
starters-question.hint: Questions often start with what or where.
starters-question.fact: A question mark (?) ends a question.

starters-radio.definition: A device that plays music and news.
starters-radio.definitionVi: Đài radio phát nhạc và tin tức.
starters-radio.hint: You turn a knob to find a station.
starters-radio.fact: Radios use invisible waves to send sound.

starters-read.definition: to look at words and understand them.
starters-read.fact: Reading every day makes you smarter.

starters-really.fact: Really adds strong feeling to a sentence.

starters-red.definition: The colour of apples and fire trucks.
starters-red.fact: Red is the first colour in a rainbow.

starters-rice.definition: Small white grains eaten with meals.
starters-rice.hint: Many Asian countries eat rice daily.
starters-rice.fact: Rice grows in wet fields called paddies.

starters-ride.definition: to sit on and travel by bike or horse.
starters-ride.definitionVi: Cưỡi hoặc đi bằng xe đạp, ngựa.
starters-ride.hint: I ride my bike to the park.
starters-ride.fact: Riding a bike keeps you fit.

starters-right.definition: Correct, or the opposite of left.
starters-right.hint: Your right hand is usually stronger.
starters-right.fact: Right also means the correct answer.

starters-robot.definition: A machine that can move and do jobs.
starters-robot.definitionVi: Robot — máy móc biết làm việc.
starters-robot.fact: Robots help build cars in factories.

starters-room.definition: A space inside a house with walls.
starters-room.hint: Your bedroom is your own room.
starters-room.fact: Houses have rooms for sleeping and eating.

starters-rubber.definition: A small tool that removes pencil marks.
starters-rubber.hint: Rub out a mistake with a rubber.
starters-rubber.fact: In America people say eraser instead.

starters-rug.definition: A soft carpet on the floor.
starters-rug.hint: Sit on the rug for story time.

starters-ruler.definition: A straight tool for measuring lines.
starters-ruler.hint: Draw straight lines with a ruler.

starters-run.definition: to move fast on your feet.
starters-run.hint: Run in the playground at break.
starters-run.fact: Running is good exercise for your heart.

starters-sad.hint: A hug can help when you feel sad.
starters-sad.fact: It is OK to feel sad sometimes.

starters-sand.definition: Tiny grains on a beach or desert.
starters-sand.definitionVi: Cát — hạt nhỏ ở bãi biển.
starters-sand.hint: You build castles with wet sand.
starters-sand.fact: Sand is made from tiny bits of rock.

starters-sausage.definition: Meat shaped like a long tube.
starters-sausage.definitionVi: Xúc xích — thịt nghiền bọc vỏ.
starters-sausage.hint: Sausages are often eaten at breakfast.

starters-say.hint: Say hello when you meet someone.
starters-say.fact: People say about 7,000 words each day.

starters-scary.hint: Dark forests can feel scary in stories.
starters-scary.fact: Scary stories are fun when you are safe.

starters-school.definition: A place where children learn and study.
starters-school.definitionVi: Trường học — nơi em đi học.
starters-school.fact: School helps you learn to read and count.

starters-sea.definition: A very large area of salty water.
starters-sea.hint: Fish and dolphins live in the sea.
starters-sea.fact: The sea covers most of our planet.

starters-see.definition: to look at something with your eyes.
starters-see.hint: I can see a bird in the tree.
starters-see.fact: Your eyes help you see colours and shapes.

starters-sentence.definition: A group of words that makes sense.
starters-sentence.definitionVi: Câu văn — nhóm từ có nghĩa.
starters-sentence.hint: Every sentence starts with a capital letter.
starters-sentence.fact: A sentence usually ends with a full stop.

starters-shell.definition: A hard cover protecting some sea animals.
starters-shell.definitionVi: Vỏ cứng bọc động vật biển.
starters-shell.hint: You find shells on the beach.
starters-shell.fact: Turtles carry shells on their backs.

starters-ship.definition: A large boat that crosses the sea.
starters-ship.definitionVi: Tàu thủy lớn đi trên biển.
starters-ship.fact: Some ships are as long as buildings.

starters-shirt.definition: Clothing you wear on your upper body.
starters-shirt.definitionVi: Áo sơ mi hoặc áo phông.
starters-shirt.hint: T-shirts are a type of shirt.
starters-shirt.fact: Shirts have buttons or pull over your head.

starters-shoe.definition: Something you wear on your foot.
starters-shoe.fact: Left and right shoes are different shapes.

starters-shop.definition: A place where you buy things.
starters-shop.hint: You pay money at the shop.
starters-shop.fact: Shops sell food, toys, and clothes.

starters-short.definition: Not long; small in height or length.
starters-short.hint: A mouse is short compared to a giraffe.
starters-short.fact: Short hair is easier to wash.

starters-shorts.definition: Trousers that stop above your knees.
starters-shorts.hint: Wear shorts on hot summer days.
starters-shorts.fact: Shorts are cool and comfy for playing.

starters-show.fact: Teachers show pictures on the board.

starters-silly.definition: Funny in a playful, not serious way.
starters-silly.fact: Being silly sometimes helps everyone relax.

starters-sing.definition: to make music with your voice.
starters-sing.hint: Sing happy birthday at a party.
starters-sing.fact: Singing together is fun in class.

starters-sister.definition: A girl who has the same parents as you.
starters-sister.definitionVi: Chị hoặc em gái trong gia đình.
starters-sister.hint: She might be older or younger.
starters-sister.fact: Sisters often play and share toys.

starters-sit.definition: to rest on a chair with your bottom.
starters-sit.hint: Sit down at your desk in class.
starters-sit.fact: Good posture means sitting up straight.

starters-skateboard.definition: A board with wheels you ride on.
starters-skateboard.hint: You push with one foot to move.

starters-skateboarding.definition: Riding and doing tricks on a skateboard.

starters-skirt.definition: Clothing that hangs from the waist down.
starters-skirt.definitionVi: Váy — mặc từ eo trở xuống.
starters-skirt.hint: Girls and women often wear skirts.
starters-skirt.fact: Skirts can be long or short.

starters-sleep.definition: to rest with your eyes closed at night.
starters-sleep.hint: Go to sleep when you feel tired.
starters-sleep.fact: Children need lots of sleep to grow.

starters-small.hint: A mouse is smaller than an elephant.
starters-small.fact: Small seeds can grow into big trees.

starters-smile.definition: A happy look on your face.
starters-smile.hint: Smile when you meet a friend.
starters-smile.fact: Smiling can make others smile too.

starters-snake.definition: A long thin animal with no legs.
starters-snake.hint: Some snakes live in the jungle.

starters-soccer.definition: A team game kicking a ball into a goal.
starters-soccer.definitionVi: Bóng đá — đá bóng vào khung thành.
starters-soccer.hint: Also called football in the UK.
starters-soccer.fact: Soccer is the world's most popular sport.

starters-sock.definition: Soft clothing that covers your foot.
starters-sock.fact: Socks keep your feet warm and dry.

starters-sofa.definition: A long soft seat in the living room.
starters-sofa.hint: The whole family sits on the sofa.
starters-sofa.fact: Some sofas can turn into beds.

starters-song.definition: Music with words you can sing.
starters-song.hint: The alphabet song helps you learn letters.
starters-song.fact: Songs can tell stories or make you dance.

starters-sorry.definition: A word you say when you did something wrong.
starters-sorry.hint: Say sorry if you bump into someone.

starters-spell.definition: to write a word letter by letter.
starters-spell.hint: Spell your name for the teacher.

starters-spider.definition: A small creature with eight legs.
starters-spider.hint: Spiders spin webs to catch flies.
starters-spider.fact: Most spiders are harmless to people.

starters-sport.definition: A game or activity with physical exercise.
starters-sport.hint: Football, tennis, and swimming are sports.
starters-sport.fact: Sport keeps your body strong and healthy.

starters-stand.definition: to be on your feet, not sitting.
starters-stand.hint: Stand up when the teacher arrives.
starters-stand.fact: Standing in a line keeps order.

starters-start.hint: Start your work when the bell rings.
starters-start.fact: Every race starts with a signal.

starters-stop.hint: Stop at a red traffic light.
starters-stop.fact: Stop signs are red and octagonal.

starters-store.definition: A shop where you buy things.
starters-store.hint: Americans say store instead of shop.
starters-store.fact: Toy stores sell games and dolls.

starters-story.definition: A tale about people, animals, or events.
starters-story.fact: Stories can be funny, scary, or exciting.

starters-street.definition: A road in a town with houses.
starters-street.hint: Look both ways before crossing the street.
starters-street.fact: Streets have names like Oak Street.

starters-sun.definition: The bright star that gives us light.
starters-sun.definitionVi: Mặt trời — chiếu sáng ban ngày.
starters-sun.hint: Never look straight at the sun.

starters-sweet-s.fact: Too many sweets are bad for teeth.

starters-swim.definition: to move through water using your arms.
starters-swim.hint: Swim in a pool with an adult nearby.
starters-swim.fact: Fish swim but people must learn how.

starters-t-shirt.definition: A casual shirt with short sleeves.
starters-t-shirt.hint: T-shirts often have pictures or words.
starters-t-shirt.fact: T-shirts are named for their T shape.

starters-table.definition: Furniture with a flat top and legs.
starters-table.definitionVi: Cái bàn — ăn hoặc học trên bàn.
starters-table.hint: You eat dinner at the table.

starters-table-tennis.definition: A fast game hitting a ball over a net.
starters-table-tennis.definitionVi: Bóng bàn — đánh bóng qua lưới.

starters-tablet.definition: A flat screen computer you touch.
starters-tablet.hint: You tap apps on a tablet.

starters-tail.definition: The long part at the back of an animal.
starters-tail.definitionVi: Đuôi — phía sau cơ thể con vật.
starters-tail.hint: Dogs wag their tails when happy.
starters-tail.fact: Monkeys use their tails to hold branches.

starters-take-a-photo.definition: to use a camera to make a picture.
starters-take-a-photo.hint: Say cheese when someone takes your photo.

starters-teacher.definition: A person who helps children learn.
starters-teacher.definitionVi: Thầy cô giáo dạy em học.
starters-teacher.hint: Your teacher reads stories and sets homework.
starters-teacher.fact: Teachers work in schools every weekday.

starters-teddy-bear.definition: A soft toy bear for cuddling.
starters-teddy-bear.hint: Many children sleep with a teddy bear.
starters-teddy-bear.fact: Teddy bears are named after a US president.

starters-television.definition: A screen that shows programmes and films.
starters-television.definitionVi: Ti-vi — xem chương trình và phim.

starters-tell.fact: Tell and say both mean speak.

starters-tennis.definition: A game hitting a ball over a net.
starters-tennis.definitionVi: Quần vợt — đánh bóng qua lưới.
starters-tennis.fact: Wimbledon is a famous tennis tournament.

starters-tennis-racket.definition: The bat used to hit a tennis ball.
starters-tennis-racket.hint: Hold the racket and swing at the ball.
starters-tennis-racket.fact: Rackets have strings in the middle.

starters-there.definition: In or at that place, not here.
starters-there.hint: Look over there by the tree.
starters-there.fact: There points to a place away from you.

starters-thing.definition: An object you can see or touch.
starters-thing.hint: A book, ball, and cup are all things.
starters-thing.fact: Thing is a useful word when you forget the name.

starters-throw.definition: to send something through the air.
starters-throw.hint: Throw the ball to your friend.

starters-tick.definition: A tiny insect that bites animals.
starters-tick.definitionVi: Con ve — côn trùng nhỏ bám da.
starters-tick.hint: Check your dog for ticks after walks.
starters-tick.fact: Ticks live in grass and woods.

starters-tiger.definition: A big wild cat with orange stripes.
starters-tiger.definitionVi: Con hổ — mèo lớn sọc cam đen.
starters-tiger.hint: Tigers live in jungles in Asia.

starters-today.definition: This day, not yesterday or tomorrow.

starters-tomato.definition: A round red fruit used in salads.
starters-tomato.definitionVi: Quả cà chua — đỏ, ăn trong salad.
starters-tomato.fact: Tomatoes are fruits but taste savoury.

starters-too.hint: I like cats too means you also like them.
starters-too.fact: Too much sugar is not healthy.

starters-toy.hint: Dolls, cars, and blocks are toys.
starters-toy.fact: Toys help children use their imagination.

starters-train.definition: A long vehicle that runs on rails.
starters-train.definitionVi: Tàu hỏa chạy trên đường ray.
starters-train.fact: Some trains go faster than cars.

starters-tree.definition: A tall plant with a trunk and branches.
starters-tree.fact: Trees give us oxygen to breathe.

starters-trousers.fact: Trousers have a zip or buttons.

starters-truck.definition: A large vehicle for carrying goods.
starters-truck.fact: Fire trucks help put out fires.

starters-try.hint: Try again if you do not succeed.
starters-try.fact: Trying new things helps you learn.

starters-tv.definition: A screen for watching shows at home.
starters-tv.hint: TV is in the living room.

starters-ugly.hint: Kind people do not call others ugly.
starters-ugly.fact: Everyone is beautiful in their own way.

starters-understand.definition: to know the meaning of something.
starters-understand.hint: Raise your hand if you understand.

starters-very.definition: A lot; to a high degree.

starters-walk.definition: to move on foot at a normal speed.
starters-walk.hint: Walk to school with a friend.
starters-walk.fact: Walking is healthy and good for Earth.

starters-wall.definition: The side of a room or building.
starters-wall.definitionVi: Bức tường của phòng hoặc nhà.
starters-wall.fact: Walls keep rooms warm and private.

starters-want.definition: to wish for or would like something.
starters-want.hint: I want an ice cream, please.
starters-want.fact: Want tells others what you hope for.

starters-watch.definition: A small clock you wear on your wrist.
starters-watch.hint: Check the time on your watch.
starters-watch.fact: Some watches do not need batteries.

starters-water.definition: A clear drink that all life needs.
starters-water.hint: Drink water when you are thirsty.
starters-water.fact: Your body is mostly made of water.

starters-watermelon.definition: A big green fruit with red juicy inside.
starters-watermelon.definitionVi: Quả dưa hấu — to, ruột đỏ ngọt.
starters-watermelon.hint: Watermelon is perfect on hot days.

starters-wave.definition: to move your hand to say hello.
starters-wave.fact: Waving is friendly in every country.

starters-wear.definition: to have clothes on your body.
starters-wear.hint: Wear a coat when it is cold.
starters-wear.fact: People wear different clothes in summer.

starters-white.definition: The colour of snow and clouds.

starters-window.definition: An opening in a wall with glass.
starters-window.hint: Open the window for fresh air.
starters-window.fact: Windows let sunlight into your room.

starters-woman.fact: Women can be doctors, teachers, or pilots.

starters-word.definition: A single unit of language with meaning.
starters-word.definitionVi: Từ vựng — một từ có nghĩa.
starters-word.hint: Cat is a short word with three letters.
starters-word.fact: English has hundreds of thousands of words.

starters-would-like.definition: to want something in a polite way.
starters-would-like.definitionVi: Muốn — nói lịch sự hơn want.
starters-would-like.hint: I would like some juice, please.
starters-would-like.fact: Would like sounds nicer than I want.

starters-write.definition: to make letters and words on paper.
starters-write.hint: Write your name at the top.

starters-year.definition: Twelve months, like January to December.
starters-year.definitionVi: Một năm có mười hai tháng.
starters-year.hint: Your birthday comes once a year.

starters-yellow.definition: The colour of the sun and bananas.
starters-yellow.fact: Yellow is bright and easy to see.

starters-yes.definition: A word that means you agree.
starters-yes.hint: Nod your head when you say yes.
starters-yes.fact: Yes is one of the first words children learn.

starters-young.definition: Not old; still a child or teenager.
starters-young.hint: A puppy is a young dog.

starters-zebra.definition: An African horse with black stripes.
starters-zebra.hint: No two zebras have the same stripes.
starters-zebra.fact: Zebras live in groups called herds.

starters-zoo.definition: A place where wild animals are kept.
starters-zoo.definitionVi: Sở thú — xem động vật hoang dã.
starters-zoo.hint: You see lions and monkeys at the zoo.
